card.name: Word starts like st, aest, ast
card.fires_on: Short word-start pieces such as "st", "St", "aest" and "ast" at the beginning of a longer word (stags, aesthetically, asthmatic, stinger, stolen). Also the odd letter "A" inside "SLAVERY".

modes.label: st- word openings
modes.description: The first piece of a word beginning with st, such as stags, stinger, stolen or Stalk.
modes.example: A herd of red<< st>>ags with huge antlers I shot

modes.label: aest/ast openings
modes.description: The piece "aest" or "ast" inside words like aesthetically or nonasthmatic.
modes.example: may result in an<< aest>>hetically undesirable outcome.

card.writes: It makes endings like "logical" less likely after these pieces, and nudges toward other word continuations.
card.plain: It fires on the first chunk of words that start with st or aest, like stags or aesthetically, when the word is split into pieces.
